programme.title: Nikhil and Jay
programme.desc: Nikhil and Jay start their own rock band! But Nikhil is deflated when Jay keeps inviting other people to join the band. Nikhil wants it to be just the two of them.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Meet the Six Times Table as she shows us all the Numberblocks who are part of her team.

programme.title: The Makery
programme.desc: Nim is going to a fancy-dress party today which gives the Makery lots of fancy animal ideas including a pigeon soap pump, a bread bird and a roar-some dinosaur hat.

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programme.desc: Get ready for a Wiggly adventure as The Wiggles are 'Dressing up In Style,' and you're invited to join in! The Wiggles host a special tea party with their adorable teddy bears, Bowie, Allen, Ollie, and Francesca.

programme.title: Play School
programme.desc: Abi and Zindzi learn how to make a wall cake for Humpty's birthday party! They create pictures with shapes for party decorations and visit Banksy's preschool. Through The Windows, we look at how teachers help us learn and grow!

programme.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
programme.desc: An asteroid heads for Earth, with the power to turn our heroes into villains. But help arrives from an unexpected source.

programme.title: Dino Dex
programme.desc: After Dex inherits his Dino Field Guide from his older sister Dana, he sets out on his grandest dinosaur experiment yet: proving that everything we thought we knew about how dinosaurs looked will have to be redrawn. Part 1.

programme.title: Little J And Big Cuz
programme.desc: When B Boy comes to stay, Little J is miffed - until they work together caring for an injured baby kangaroo.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Whilst exploring deep space, a meteor strikes Cosima and Dad's ship! Crash-landing on the unexplored planet of Proxima, Cosima makes a new best friend - Big Lizard!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou takes a moment for himself and sings a thinking song.

programme.title: Gardening Australia Junior
programme.desc: Hannah and the junior gardeners make pots so magical; they disappear into the garden!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa and George are playing in their pool on a hot day. Peppa and George help the garden animals cool down too but when it rains, the animals are happy and so is Peppa. Rain makes muddy puddles for jumping in!

programme.title: Tabby McTat
programme.desc: In the bustling heart of London, Tabby McTat and his busker friend Fred delight crowds with their harmonious duets until an unexpected separation tears them apart.

programme.title: Super Monsters
programme.desc: Katya's magic mishap at the library creates chaos, but her Super Monster friends help her fix the mess, teaching her that even a 'good witch' sometimes needs help from others.

programme.title: The Octonauts
programme.desc: The Octonauts must help a giant sunfish who can't swim straight, before it hurts other sea creatures and itself.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Amaya's friends Marie and Jennie get entranced and imperilled by Luna Girl.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Emerald
programme.desc: When Delphina invites herself for a sleepover at Emerald's, Emerald worries that Delphina won't enjoy it, being more used to the grandeur of the palace. She does all she can to put her off but Delphina proves her wrong!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
programme.desc: Join the chickens into Space and encounter alien chickens, travel with Phileas Frog in pursuit of the Lock Ness Monster and finally enjoy some splashing around with Happy.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: The veggies are showing off their superhero sidekick costumes in a contest that Supertato is judging.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piris look after a special package for Shirley but get more than they bargained for!

programme.title: Let's Go, Bananas!
programme.desc: Stellar proves her innocence by playing detectives with Josh.and pinning the blame on Piper.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Mum and Dad have a disagreement, Bluey makes Dad write a love letter to Mum to make up. Now Bluey must find a way to play Ground's Lava with Bingo and deliver the letter to Mum, without squabbling.

programme.title: The InBESTigators
